name: Beefmaster
notes: Composite breed developed in the 1930s by Tom Lasater (Hereford × Shorthorn × Brahman). First composite breed registered in the US. Carries ~25% Brahman influence, giving heat tolerance, tick resistance, and hybrid vigor in crossbreeding — especially in the Gulf Coast, Southwest US, and tropical/subtropical regions. BBU moved to MONTHLY evaluations in 2024 via the DigitalBeef platform. GE-EPDs require the 100K Neogen SNP panel (only option as of September 2025). Ultrasound and yearling weight window: 320-450 days (updated Sept 2024). UGC Certified technician required for ultrasound. Reports IMF% (ultrasound), NOT a marbling-score EPD — do NOT apply the Brahman 100x marbling scale multiplier.

traits.label: Calving Ease Direct
traits.description: % unassisted births from the sire to first-calf heifers.

traits.label: Birth Weight
traits.description: Progeny birth-weight difference. Lower favored for heifer bulls.

traits.label: Yearling Weight
traits.description: Progeny weight at ~365 days. Scan window 320-450 days.

traits.label: Maternal Milk
traits.description: Mothering ability in daughters — central to Beefmaster's 'Milk Production' essential.

traits.label: Calving Ease Maternal
traits.description: % unassisted births from the sire's daughters.

traits.label: Scrotal Circumference
traits.description: Fertility indicator; correlates with daughter age at puberty. Central to Beefmaster's 'Fertility' essential.

traits.label: Intramuscular Fat %
traits.description: Ultrasound IMF% — reported in tenths of a percent difference. Beefmaster does NOT publish a marbling-score EPD.

traits.label: Docility / Disposition
traits.description: Disposition score — tied to Beefmaster's 'Disposition' essential. Higher = more docile.

indexes.label: Terminal Index
indexes.description: For producers NOT keeping replacement females. Focuses purely on growth and carcass — no maternal traits weighted.

indexes.label: Maternal Index
indexes.description: For producers keeping replacement females. Predicts replacement female performance while maximizing pounds on steer mates.
